steps.label: What to do when a pin becomes uninstallable
steps.sub: Document it — don't silently re-run and report the old number

code:
# A direct pin isn't enough -- it
# doesn't pin qiskit's OWN internal
# deps (rustworkx, symengine, ...)

uv lock
# or, for pip:
pip freeze >
  requirements-lock-exp-grover-
  10q-2026-10-18.txt
caption: Naming the frozen snapshot after the experiment tag makes the connection explicit and searchable, not implicit and easy to lose.

eyebrow: Tying the environment to the experiment tag
code:
git add uv.lock
git commit -m "Lock environment for
  10-qubit Grover resource estimate"
git tag -a exp-grover-10q-2026-10-18
  -m "Resource estimate + locked
  environment, see results.md 4.2"
git push origin main --tags
caption: git show exp-...:uv.lock now retrieves the exact dependency tree active when the result was produced.
